entries.reachability_signal: Test 2 (data_len=7) receives MGMT_STATUS_SUCCESS instead of MGMT_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMS, proving the '>' comparison at line 9149 was executed and the extra bytes were tolerated. gcov should show line 9149 as covered.
entries.expected_signal: test 1 (exact_len=6): ACCEPTED; test 2 (extra_len=7): ACCEPTED (after patch); test 3 (short_len=5): REJECTED with MGMT_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMS; test 4 (min_len=3): ACCEPTED
entries.input_strategy: Sends MGMT_OP_ADD_EXT_ADV_DATA with adv_data_len=2, scan_rsp_len=1 (expected_len=6) at varying data_len: 3 (min struct), 5 (too short), 6 (exact match), 7 (extra byte). Tests the old-new validation boundary: old != rejects 7, new > accepts 7. Input axes: exact boundary (6), null/empty (3), old-invalid (7), maximum/overflow (255+255).
prerequisites: Kernel with CONFIG_BT=y, CONFIG_BT_MGMT=y, CONFIG_BT_HCIBTUSB=y or CONFIG_BT_HCIUART=y or CONFIG_BT_HCIVHCI=y
Bluetooth HCI device (real or virtual via hci_vhci)
gcc and libc headers for building the reproducer
entries.limitations: Requires a running kernel with Bluetooth MGMT enabled and an HCI device present. Cannot be run as a standalone user-space test without kernel support. A full kernel build + QEMU VM with Bluetooth is needed for automated testing. For manual verification on a live system with Bluetooth hardware, run: sudo bash test-entry-work/PCA-0001/reproducer.sh
